blurb: Guests fish inshore waters of St. Andrews Bay or offshore near-coastal Gulf of Mexico targeting various species including Red Fish, Speckled Trout, Flounder, Red Snapper, and sharks. Trips are guided by USCG-licensed Captain Andrew Nguyen using light tackle techniques. Shark fishing and Tarpon catch-and-release trips are specialty offerings.
